assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square original card portrait for a painted fantasy strategy game
Primary request: An original portrait of the Sunthread Pair, exactly two woodland ranged wardens who protect the paths through the valley.
Scene/backdrop: A shallow-focus woodland edge near a root bridge, with soft late-afternoon sunlight between broad tree trunks.
Subject: Exactly two alert adult wardens, close enough to read as a pair but with separate silhouettes. Both wear practical ochre and muted saffron cloth, dark leather bracers, and small copper-thread details sewn into their hems. Each carries a distinct handmade yew bow with clearly visible fine copper lacing along the limbs; show the bows and both faces clearly. One warden has dark braided hair and aims a bow downward at rest; the other has short chestnut curls and holds their bow upright. Their faces are original, calm, and watchful.
Style/medium: Original hand-painted fantasy card illustration with softly sculpted forms, controlled brushwork, matte surfaces, crisp readable silhouettes, and warm atmospheric depth.
Composition/framing: Square close group portrait from waist-up; exactly two figures, both heads and both complete bow silhouettes visible, figures fill the frame and remain easy to distinguish at small card-thumbnail size.
Lighting/mood: Warm upper-left sun filtering through trees, calm and vigilant.
Color palette: Ochre cloth, dark bark, fern green, copper accents, amber sunlight.
Materials/textures: Woven linen, worn leather, handmade yew, fine copper wire, softly painted foliage.
Text (verbatim): None.
Constraints: Exactly two original woodland wardens and two bows. Keep copper lacing visibly part of each bow. No symbols, captions, letters, UI, frame, border, watermark, or logos.
Avoid: Any copied commercial-game character or recognizable design; pink hair; matching outfits or identical faces; blue skin; armor-heavy knights; swords, shields, crossbows, guns; extra figures or weapons; photorealism; glossy plastic; flat vector art; text.
